description.value:
This system destabilizes enemy mech machinery with electromagnetic pulses.

Jam Weapon (3 PP): Disable an enemy mech's weapon for 1 minute.

Kill Engine (4 PP): Reduce an enemy mech's movement speed to 0 for 1 round.

Sabotage Power (3 PP): Prevent an enemy mech from expending power points for 1 round.

Save DC: 12 + half mech tier.
